content:
- name: Compare int64-capable owner with the unchanged live floating-point oracle (32 cases)
        run: |
          echo '554671168c7a4a408dc1e1df89a19db15c3efcefcf4ae1a300af1b6dcae40160  tests/pytorch_tensor_rng_backward_oracle.py' | sha256sum -c -
          status=0
          python3 tests/pytorch_tensor_rng_backward_oracle.py \
            --native build/integer-tensors/tensor-integer-session \
            --source build/integer-tensors/runtime.hepta \
            --expected-native-sha256 b7324639bade3312981d1cbf9c2491b9fcff04fb6c3f808e9c5e1a7c2ca88f08 \
            --expected-source-sha256 adf6cae67666273aa6fb77989080ca3b1e3632188d2d7956a6d8b71808787e62 \
            --repo . --output build/pytorch-integer-tensors-backward.json > build/pytorch-integer-tensors-backward.stdout || status=$?
          python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/pytorch-integer-tensors-backward.json
          exit "$status"

      - name: Regress int64-capable owner on all original35 F32 cases with full 640-byte accounting
        run: |
          echo '149b41c455444edeb8d25d0ad98045e29683e780f37f7e210e7985242d359597  tests/tensor_object_oracle/pytorch_tensor_objects_oracle.py' | sha256sum -c -
          status=0
          python3 tests/integer_frozen35_accounting/run_frozen35_accounted.py \
            --legacy-directory tests/tensor_object_oracle \
            --native-source build/integer-tensors/runtime.hepta \
            --observer-output build/frozen35-integer-node/544 \
            --observer-report build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35.json \
            -- build/integer-tensors/tensor-integer-session build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35-original.json \
            --owned-reference tests/owned_tensor_oracle/pytorch_owned_tensor_oracle.py \
            --session-reference tests/pytorch_session_oracle.py --reference tests/pytorch_oracle.py \
            --lock compatibility/pytorch-oracle-lock.json --repo . \
            --trace-directory build/frozen35-integer-node-wire/544 \
            --expected-native-sha256 b7324639bade3312981d1cbf9c2491b9fcff04fb6c3f808e9c5e1a7c2ca88f08 || status=$?
          if [ -f build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35.json ]; then
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35.json
          fi
          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
            python3 -I -S -B tests/integer_frozen35_accounting/check_frozen35_accounted.py \
              --observer-report build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35.json \
              --original-report build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35-original.json
          fi
          exit "$status"

      - name: Check original18 copied refusals against the int64-profile full35 journals
        run: |
          status=0
          python3 -I -S -B tests/integer_frozen35_accounting/check_owner_snapshots.py \
            --observer tests/integer_frozen35_accounting/owner_accounting_int64.py \
            --expected-profile integer-tensor-544-fixed35-F32 \
            --journals build/frozen35-integer-node/544/owners \
            --output build/frozen35-integer-node/544/copied-controls || status=$?
          if [ -f build/frozen35-integer-node/544/copied-controls/report.json ]; then
            cp build/frozen35-integer-node/544/copied-controls/report.json build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35-observer-controls.json
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/pytorch-integer-tensors-frozen35-observer-controls.json
          fi
          exit "$status"
